suggestion.title: Elongate Your Profile
suggestion.body: Flowy tops, V-necks, and open cardigans are great for elongating your silhouette and drawing attention vertically. Avoid overly tight belts around the midsection.

recommended_items.advice: Swing tops skim over the midsection, creating a flattering silhouette without clinging to the tummy area.
Draped tops create soft lines that camouflage the midsection while adding elegant movement.
Tunic tops provide extra length and coverage, drawing attention away from the waist and creating a balanced look.
Wrap tops define the waist and create the illusion of a more balanced silhouette while flattering the bust.
Trapeze tops flare gently away from the body, providing comfort while minimizing focus on the midsection.

avoid_items.advice: Avoid crop tops, as they draw attention to the midsection and can make the tummy area more prominent.
Avoid tight-fitted tops, as they cling to the tummy and emphasize the widest part of the body.

general_advice: Choose tops that skim over the midsection while drawing attention to the neckline and shoulders.

recommended_items.advice: Bootcut pants create balance by adding subtle width below the knee, complementing an apple body shape.
Cargo pants add visual interest to the lower body, helping balance a fuller upper body.
Flared pants create a balanced silhouette by adding volume below the knee.
Flowy pants drape smoothly over the legs, creating an elongated and flattering silhouette.
Wide-leg pants balance the wider midsection with the slimmer legs, creating more harmonious proportions.

avoid_items.advice: Avoid very tapered pants, as they emphasize slim legs and can make the upper body appear larger.
Avoid high-waisted pants if they emphasize the tummy area and draw attention to the midsection.
Avoid pants with front pleats, as they can add unnecessary volume around the tummy.
Avoid pants with front ruching, as they can highlight the midsection instead of creating a smooth silhouette.

general_advice: Choose pants that balance the upper body by adding volume or movement to the lower half while keeping the front of the waist smooth.
